_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — written against capture_map.json in this folder. Every narration line traces to a frame; S06 is a deliberate [GAP] showing what happens when the footage does not establish what the narration would need to say.

objectives.text: Raise a purchase requisition for a stocked item from the Fiori launchpad
Assign a cost centre so the requisition releases for approval

glossary.note: The client's term throughout. 'PR' is acceptable spoken only after the first full use.
British spelling, per the client style guide

scenes.narration: Welcome. In this module you'll raise a purchase requisition for a stocked item in S four HANA. We'll start from the Fiori launchpad and finish with a requisition number.

Open the Procurement group and select Create Purchase Requisition. Enter the material number on the first line. The description and unit of measure fill in automatically from the material master, so leave those alone.
Now assign the cost centre. This field is mandatory for stocked items, and the requisition will not release without a valid one.

scenes.gap_note: The approval status chip is truncated at the frame edge, so the recording does not establish who a stocked-item requisition routes to. Consultant to confirm the routing rule before this scene is narrated.

scenes.narration: That's the requisition created, with its number shown in the page header. Check the approval status under My Requisitions tomorrow, and contact the service desk if it hasn't moved by then.
